summary.text: Nick Salazar is the Democratic candidate for the Iowa House of Representatives, District 96, in the November 3, 2026 general election, in which incumbent Mark Cisneros (R) is also running.
He works in manufacturing and advanced from the Democratic primary on June 2, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Nick Salazar graduated from Muscatine High School and works in manufacturing.

In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he was born and raised in Muscatine, that his family came from Texas in the 1960s to work in the Heinz tomato fields, and that he has worked as a supply chain leader at the Heinz Muscatine plant for 20 years.
Salazar listed support for working families and affordability, funding public schools, and investing in infrastructure and the environment among his campaign priorities.
